task: Each source has two targets: finite2 with new response parameters, or recurrent with the original response parameters. Both targets share paid prefix controls. Private family labels and seeds appear only in the experiment protocol/results.
source: Reuse the two actual confirmed Luna source archives from /home/erzhu419/mine_code/Asumption Agent/Hegel Machine/artifacts/candidate_retention_cycle_luna_20261006
intervention: Both conditions compute research advice from already paid results. The experiment-only no_advice subclass returns None from the rendering hook, before feedback, operator results or ordinary files are saved. It retains the same explicit research_choice, refit and other tools. Advice is shown after evaluation, failed confirmation and numerical operator results, including successful repair steps that enable later evaluation or submission.
controller: Every action after the matched three-trajectory prefix is selected by Luna. Neither condition forces an initial action or follows advice automatically. Same model, prompt, tools, budgets and confirmation seeds; maximum 12 model calls.
archive_publication: New predictors retain ordinary code, data and binary dependencies. Imported confirmed-model archives accompany them only when declared in the successful finish.reused_files. Runner logs and the undeclared candidate catalog are excluded. An unchanged directly submitted archive keeps its existing dependencies. Revisions to an inherited model publish a new candidate. A latest predictor explicitly depending on an older candidate retains that dependency, which is reported.
failure_policy: Keep every registered target and service failure; no replacement or retry.
accounting: Report actual token/cache usage, observations, computation and execution for each condition. Shared existing source learning is reported separately and is not consumed again. Advice computes no new numerical fit or observation.
terminal_order: Every source and target stops learning before any 128-row terminal evaluation. Source admission uses fresh confirmation only, never terminal outcomes.
scope: Eight live episodes on four previously examined development tasks. The paired intervention tests visibility of concrete advice, not a new independent task cohort or a complete vanilla-versus-Hegel comparison.
model_identity: gpt-6-luna is requested through the existing subscription provider. Usage metadata repeating that name does not independently establish server routing.
adoption: Record the actual recommended next action at the rendering hook privately. For multiple recommendations within one event, earlier ones are superseded; only the final advice is compared with the next actual event, using exact action/required-argument matching. A match in no_advice is counterfactual alignment, not adoption of an unseen recommendation. No inference from text.
